question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**weeping**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the sentence involves a reaction to an event where the boy is genuinely in distress because a wolf is attacking the sheep.
 
• The appropriate emotional response in such a distressing and urgent situation would be sadness or fear, not joy or celebration.
 
• The word "**weeping**" (रोना) means crying, which matches the boy's state of despair upon realizing the gravity of the situation.
